title: On Venus, the Sun Rises in the West
hook: Venus spins the opposite way from Earth, so the sun rises in the west
summary: Venus spins backward, so the sun rises in the west, and one spin takes longer than its whole year.

text: It's about the same size as Earth, but it spins the exact opposite way.
Most planets spin in place in the same direction.
the sun rises in the west and sets in the east.

panels.text: So there really is a place where the sun rises in the west

text: One full spin in place takes 243 days.
